title: timeline.json
description: Engine-agnostic timeline (all times in SECONDS). build-props emits this; per-engine compilers (Remotion frames / HyperFrames seconds) translate it. Decouples the sync logic from any one render engine so the engine becomes swappable. CONTRACT: every time is FRAME-ACCURATE — quantized once at format.fps by the timeline builder (lib/timeline.mjs) so all engine compilers reconstruct the exact same frame numbers (Math.round(seconds*fps)) and never re-derive timing from the alignment.

fps.description: Advisory; the timeline itself is in seconds.

crossfade_seconds.description: Scene blend overlap; consecutive scene windows overlap by this much.

motion.description: Motion budget from the resolved format recipe (intensity/ambient/emphasis…); passed through to the engine.

engine.description: Which renderer draws this scene (default remotion). hyperframes = pre-rendered silent hero clip composited at the scene window (V6).

props.description: Template-specific props (engine-agnostic). MOTIVATED-MOTION windows here carry ABSOLUTE video-second timing: focalZoom/pip expose inAtSeconds / outAtSeconds (null = scene start / hold to scene end); engine compilers convert these to their own frame/offset representation.

reveals.description: Per-element reveal times (seconds), snapped to spoken words.

captions.description: Caption cues; words timed to the narration (<= 2 lines enforced downstream).
